sections.description:
AI Alt Text Generator for WordPress & WooCommerce 🚀

AutoAlt.ai is an AI alt text generator for WordPress and WooCommerce. It analyzes image content and creates descriptive alt text, image titles, captions, descriptions and SEO-friendly filenames directly inside WordPress.

Generate alt text automatically when an image is uploaded, create it for one image on demand or use the bulk alt text generator for an existing Media Library. AutoAlt.ai also helps you find images with missing alt text, unusually short alt text and poor filenames, so you can work on the images that need attention.

Stop losing traffic AND risking fines. Every image without alt text costs you twice: lost Google Image Search visibility AND potential EAA fines (EU) or ADA lawsuits (USA).

AutoAlt generates SEO-optimized, accessible alt texts in seconds – fully WCAG 2.1 AA compliant.

✨ Key Features

➜ Generate AI-powered alt text from image content
➜ Automatically generate alt text during image upload
➜ Generate or regenerate alt text for single image
➜ Bulk generate alt text for existing Media Library images
➜ Generate from the Media Library and WordPress editor
➜ Find images with missing alt text
➜ Find short alt text that may need review and fix
➜ Process only images attached to posts, pages or products
➜ Skip images previously processed by AutoAlt.ai
➜ Review and regenerate results from generation history

50 Credits per month free No Credit Card • Free Forever

Demo Video

Generate complete WordPress image metadata

AutoAlt.ai can generate more than alternative text. Create image titles, captions and descriptions for new or existing media.

For each metadata field, choose:

  • Generate – create new content with AI
  • Keep – preserve the existing value
  • Clear – remove the current value

These controls are available for alt text, title, caption and description, giving you more control during individual and bulk workflows.

AI image filename generation and bulk image renaming

Descriptive filenames can provide light additional context to search engines and make Media Libraries easier to manage. AutoAlt.ai can:

✔ Generate an SEO-friendly filename from image content
✔ Rename images automatically during upload
✔ Bulk rename existing WordPress images
✔ Detect poor, unclear or generic filenames
✔ Keep a rename history
✔ Undo supported filename changes

WooCommerce product image optimization

AutoAlt.ai supports WooCommerce product-image workflows. It can use the WooCommerce product name as additional context when generating content for product images and galleries. This helps the generated text describe the image in relation to the product instead of relying only on a generic visual summary.

SEO focus keyword integrations

Use focus keywords from supported WordPress SEO plugins as optional generation context:

✔ Yoast SEO
✔ Rank Math SEO
✔ All in One SEO
✔ SEOPress
✔ The SEO Framework
✔ SmartCrawl
✔ Squirrly SEO

You can also add custom SEO keywords, exclude unwanted or negative keywords and add prefix or suffix text. Keywords should remain relevant to the image and page. AutoAlt.ai is designed to support useful descriptions, not keyword stuffing.

Control how the AI writes

Adapt generated metadata to your website and editorial requirements:

➜ Custom AI prompts
➜ Writing-tone selection
➜ Minimum and maximum alt-text length
➜ Custom SEO keywords
➜ Negative keywords
➜ Prefix and suffix text
➜ Individual editing and regeneration
➜ Generate, Keep and Clear controls

Multilingual alt text

Generate alt text and image metadata in more than 100 languages. AutoAlt.ai supports multilingual WordPress workflows with WPML and Polylang, making it suitable for international websites and WooCommerce stores.

Supported image formats

AutoAlt.ai supports:

✔ JPG and JPEG
✔ PNG
✔ WebP
✔ GIF
✔ SVG
✔ AVIF

History, filters and troubleshooting

➜ Generation history with individual editing and regeneration
➜ Rename history and Undo functionality
➜ Attached-images-only filtering
➜ Skip previously processed images
➜ Error logging
➜ Email notifications
➜ Domain-secured API connection
➜ Staging and live website support

Image SEO and accessibility workflows

Useful alt text can help screen-reader users understand informative images and can give search engines additional image context. AutoAlt.ai helps identify missing or short alt text and creates a useful first draft for review.

The correct text alternative depends on the image’s purpose and page context. Decorative images may need an empty alt attribute, functional images should describe their action, and complex charts or diagrams may need a longer human-written explanation. No plugin alone can guarantee WCAG, ADA, EAA, BFSG or other legal compliance.

🇩🇪 Made in Germany

AutoAlt is developed by webAufstieg GmbH in Aalen, Germany. Your image data is processed with strict privacy standards:

  • GDPR Compliant – German company, EU data protection
  • No Data Storage – Images processed, then deleted
  • German Support – Real humans, real help

Privacy-focused processing

AutoAlt.ai is operated by webAufstieg GmbH in Germany.

According to the AutoAlt.ai Privacy Policy:

✔ Images are not permanently stored after processing
✔ Images are not used to train AI models
✔ EXIF metadata is removed before transmission to AI providers
✔ Account identifiers, domains and filenames are not sent to AI providers
✔ A Data Processing Agreement is available on request

Review the full Privacy Policy before using the service:
https://www.autoalt.ai/privacy-policy/

50 free credits every month

Every AutoAlt.ai account includes 50 free credits per month. No credit card is required for the Free Plan. Additional credit packs and subscriptions are available for larger Media Libraries and product catalogues.

Why choose AutoAlt.ai?

AutoAlt.ai combines several image workflows in one WordPress plugin:

➜ Automatic, individual and bulk AI alt text generation
➜ Missing and short alt-text detection
➜ Titles, captions and descriptions
➜ Generate, Keep and Clear metadata controls
➜ Poor-filename detection and AI image renaming
➜ Rename history and Undo
➜ WooCommerce product-name context
➜ Focus-keyword integrations with leading SEO plugins
➜ More than 100 languages with WPML and Polylang support
➜ Modern image formats including SVG and AVIF
➜ 50 free credits every month

External Services

AutoAlt.ai connects to the AutoAlt.ai API when a user requests generation, starts a bulk process or enables automatic generation during upload.

Depending on the enabled features, the plugin may send the image or image URL, selected language, generation settings, custom prompt, SEO keywords, negative keywords, prefix/suffix text and WooCommerce product context to the AutoAlt.ai service. The domain and API credentials are used to authenticate the connection and manage credits.

AutoAlt.ai uses OpenAI and Google Gemini for image analysis and text generation. According to the AutoAlt.ai Privacy Policy, EXIF metadata is removed before transmission; images are not permanently stored; images are not used for model training; and customer account identifiers, domains and filenames are not passed to the AI providers.

The service is required for AI generation. Existing WordPress metadata can still be viewed and edited without requesting generation.

sections.installation:
Automatic installation

  1. In WordPress, go to Plugins > Add New.
  2. Search for “AutoAlt” or “AI Alt Text Generator”.
  3. Install and activate AutoAlt.ai.
  4. Open AutoAlt.ai in the WordPress admin area.
  5. Register a new account or connect an existing AutoAlt.ai account.
  6. Confirm the domain and API connection.
  7. Generate alt text for one image, run a bulk process or enable automatic generation during upload.

Manual installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file.
  2. In WordPress, go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  3. Upload the ZIP file and select Install Now.
  4. Activate the plugin.
  5. Open AutoAlt.ai and connect your account.

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.2 or later
  • PHP 7.2 or later
  • An active internet connection for AI generation
sections.faq:
What is AutoAlt.ai?

AutoAlt.ai is an AI alt text generator and image SEO plugin for WordPress and WooCommerce. It generates alternative text, titles, captions, descriptions and SEO-friendly image filenames from image content.

Can AutoAlt.ai generate alt text automatically during image upload?

Yes. Enable automatic generation for new image uploads. You can also generate alt text for one image manually or process existing images in bulk.

Can I bulk generate alt text for my existing WordPress Media Library?

Yes. The bulk alt text generator processes existing images and includes filters for missing alt text, short alt text, attached images and images previously processed by AutoAlt.ai.

Can AutoAlt.ai find images with missing or poor alt text?

AutoAlt.ai can filter images with missing alt text and detect unusually short alt text for review. It can also identify images with poor or generic filenames.

Does AutoAlt.ai work with WooCommerce product images?

Yes. AutoAlt.ai supports WooCommerce product images and galleries. It can use the product name as additional context when generating image metadata.

Which WordPress SEO plugins are supported?

AutoAlt.ai supports focus-keyword context from Yoast SEO, Rank Math SEO, All in One SEO, SEOPress, The SEO Framework, SmartCrawl and Squirrly SEO.

Can AutoAlt.ai rename WordPress image files?

Yes. AutoAlt.ai can generate descriptive filenames, rename images during upload and bulk rename existing images. Rename history and Undo are available for supported filename changes.

Can I generate image titles, captions and descriptions?

Yes. Choose Generate, Keep or Clear independently for alt text, title, caption and description.

Does AutoAlt.ai support WPML and Polylang?

Yes. AutoAlt.ai supports multilingual workflows with WPML and Polylang and can generate metadata in more than 100 languages.

Which image formats are supported?

JPG, JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, SVG and AVIF are supported. Images smaller than 30×30 px (icons and tracking pixels) are skipped automatically. Supported Image Formats

Are my images stored or used for AI training?

According to the AutoAlt.ai Privacy Policy, images are not permanently stored and are not used to train AI models. EXIF metadata is removed before image data is transmitted to the AI providers. Review the Privacy Policy for full processing details.

Does AutoAlt.ai automatically make my website WCAG, ADA, EAA or BFSG compliant?

No plugin can guarantee complete accessibility or legal compliance by itself. AutoAlt.ai helps identify missing or short alt text and generate drafts. Results should be reviewed in page context, especially for decorative, functional and complex images.

Does it work with Elementor, Divi, and other page builders?

Yes. AutoAlt.ai saves alt text directly to the native WordPress media library, so it works with Elementor, Divi, Beaver Builder, Gutenberg blocks, and any theme or page builder that uses the media library.

Will generated metadata remain if I deactivate or uninstall the plugin?

Yes. Saved alt text, titles, captions and descriptions remain in the standard WordPress media fields after the plugin is deactivated or removed. Renamed files remain renamed unless a supported Undo action is completed before removal.

How many free credits do I receive?

Every AutoAlt.ai account includes 50 free credits each month. Additional credits and paid plans are available for larger image libraries.

Where can I get support?

You can contact our support team through the AutoAlt.ai Contact Page. We’ll be happy to help with installation, setup, troubleshooting, billing, or any questions about the plugin.

How does AutoAlt.ai generate alt text?

AutoAlt.ai uses advanced AI vision models to analyze the actual content of each image and write a natural, descriptive alt text — with roughly 99% accuracy. You can add SEO focus keywords, a custom prompt, and a writing tone to shape the output.
